hypothesis: A technically enforced no-AI mode during graded assessments prevents AI-assisted submissions and yields defensible integrity for CE credit issuance.

primary_metric.name: bypass_rate
primary_metric.definition: Attempts that successfully invoke any AI surface during an active assessment session.
primary_metric.success_threshold: 0% bypass across the full pen-test matrix

analysis_plan.primary_test: binary pass/fail per attack vector, all must pass
analysis_plan.stopping_rule: no peeking; analysis only at min_window_days+1
analysis_plan.missing_data_policy: any untested vector counts as fail

compliance_review.reason: Assessment integrity is gating for CE credit issuance
